note: Bates Township park on Sunset Lake 3 miles northeast of Iron River, with a swimming beach, fishing pier, boat launch, pavilion, ball field and playground. Grass and gravel sites (UP Travel lists 13). Hookups not published - call the township. --Claude
summary: Township parks page (the park has no page of its own; its section is https://www.batestownship.com/parks-and-recreation/#Sunset-Lake) + 2024-2028 Recreation Plan: $20/night (one rate, confirmed), reserve by phone ext. 6, showers. Cleared sites.count 13 (UP Travel listing only). Not stated: season dates, hookups, site count, rig length.
